verdict.rationale: A tax-filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no product-native way to configure background automations. Post-dating a single Webfile payment is an adjacent scheduling control, and the keyless open-data SODA endpoint is a read-only developer building block, not an automation capability. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec for filing or payment, and Webfile works only inside an authenticated eSystems session.
